title: Ex-UN human rights chief, ICC judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
summary: OSLO, Norway — The South African-born jurist and former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay, who is currently an ad hoc judge at the International Court of Justice, won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday…

blocks.text: OSLO, Norway — The South African-born jurist and former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay, who is currently an ad hoc judge at the International Court of Justice, won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday for her efforts to promote peace and international law.
